# Evergreen Cafe & Restaurant — Complete Knowledge Base & Menu Reference

> Full context specification for AI search agents, LLMs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Restaurant Overview

Evergreen Cafe & Restaurant is an established single-restaurant food platform located in Ambagarh Chowki, Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh. The restaurant specializes in providing high-quality, freshly prepared meals with fast local delivery and takeaway services.

- **Legal / Brand Name:** Evergreen Cafe & Restaurant
- **Short Name:** Evergreen Cafe
- **Exact Address:** Ravan Gali, Nisha Complex, Ambagarh Chowki, Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh - 491665
- **District:** Rajnandgaon
- **Pincode:** 491665
- **Geo Coordinates:** Latitude: 20.7816, Longitude: 80.7417
- **Phone Number:** +91 98765 43210
- **Email Address:** support@evergreen.com
- **Customer Support:** Available daily from 10:00 AM to 10:30 PM via phone, WhatsApp, and live order chat.

## Detailed Culinary Menu & Pricing Spectrum

### Starters & Appetizers
- **Paneer Tikka (8 pcs):** Tender cottage cheese cubes marinated in aromatic spices and grilled in tandoor. ₹220
- **Veg Spring Rolls:** Crispy golden rolls stuffed with shredded vegetables and served with sweet chilli dip. ₹160
- **Crispy Chilli Baby Corn:** Fried baby corn tossed in spicy Schezwan sauce with peppers. ₹180
- **Chicken 65:** Spicy deep-fried chicken morsels seasoned with South Indian spices and curry leaves. ₹240

### Main Course (Curries & Gravies)
- **Paneer Butter Masala:** Rich tomato-butter gravy with succulent paneer cubes. ₹240
- **Kadai Paneer:** Spicy paneer cooked with capsicum, onion, and fresh ground spices. ₹230
- **Dal Tadka / Dal Makhani:** Slow-cooked lentils tampered with ghee, cumin, and garlic. ₹180
- **Butter Chicken:** Mildly spiced, creamy tomato-butter curry with roasted chicken chunks. ₹290
- **Chicken Curry (Home Style):** Traditional recipe cooked with onion, ginger, and aromatic spices. ₹270

### Indian Breads & Rice
- **Butter Naan / Garlic Naan:** Tandoor baked flatbread brushed with butter or garlic. ₹40 - ₹60
- **Tandoori Roti:** Whole wheat tandoori bread. ₹25
- **Hyderabadi Veg Biryani:** Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced vegetables and herbs. ₹210
- **Chicken Dum Biryani:** Authentic dum biryani with marinated chicken piece and aromatic rice. ₹260

### Indo-Chinese & Fast Food
- **Veg Hakka Noodles:** Wok-tossed noodles with colorful bell peppers and spring onion. ₹170
- **Chicken Schezwan Noodles:** Fiery noodles cooked in house Schezwan chili paste. ₹200
- **Classic Veg Burger / Cheese Burger:** Grilled patty with lettuce, tomato, and cheese slice. ₹110 - ₹140

### Beverages & Shakes
- **Cold Coffee with Ice Cream:** Rich blended espresso with milk and vanilla scoop. ₹120
- **Fresh Lime Soda:** Sweet or salted refreshing sparkling drink. ₹60
- **Masala Chai:** Special aromatic Indian tea infused with cardamom and ginger. ₹30

## Operating & Delivery Guidelines

- **Service Radius:** Ambagarh Chowki town (491665), Nisha Complex area, Ravan Gali, and 5km surrounding radius.
- **Minimum Order Value:** No minimum order (Delivery charge ₹30 applies for orders under ₹300).
- **Free Delivery:** Automatic free delivery on orders ₹300 and above.
- **Order Cancellation Policy:** Allowed within 2 minutes of placing order before kitchen acceptance.
- **Refund Policy:** Instant replacement or refund credit for verified incorrect or damaged items.
